claims: NASA’s Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026, from Kennedy Space Center.
NASA’s Artemis II mission sent four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon.
Artemis II uses NASA’s SLS rocket and Orion capsule.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight around the Moon since 1972.
Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) and Orion capsule.
10-day journey around the moon and back.
Artemis II uses NASA’s SLS, not SpaceX's Falcon 9 or Starship.
SpaceX is contracted to provide the Starship Human Landing System (HLS) for Artemis III.
Artemis III is planned to land astronauts on the moon in 2027 or 2028.
SpaceX continues to conduct independent launches, such as Starlink, during the Artemis II mission.
